newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian centre says working on telecom merger.
newsitem.headline: Russian centre says working on telecom merger.

text.p: The Russian Privatisation Centre is helping the State Property Committee, Russia's privatisation ministry, work on a plan to merge telecoms holding company AO Svyazinvest and national telecoms group Rostelekom, a privatisation centre spokeswoman said on Thursday.
She told Reuters plans for a merger would be drawn up in two weeks. The privatisation centre had been handling the sale of a 25 percent stake in Svyazinvest to a strategic investor.

Earlier, Interfax news agency quoted the chairman of the State Property Committee, Alfred Kokh, as saying the committee was working on plans to merge the two companies and then sell a significant stake in the combined company to raise $1-2 billion.
Rostelekom shares were quoted at $2.50 at 1600 GMT, having fallen from $2.55 before the news. They closed at $2.61 on Wednesday.
